# Copilot instructions

This repository maintains RacePal's public architecture and engineering documentation. The application implementation is proprietary and is not included here.

Before editing, read `AGENTS.md`, `PRODUCT.md`, `docs/02-ARCHITECTURE.md`, and the relevant documentation section. Work on approved documentation or synthetic examples only.

- Do not reconstruct source code, numerical algorithms, internal contracts, private endpoints, credentials, or proprietary prompts.
- Do not copy private repository content into this documentation tree without explicit approval and review.
- Distinguish implemented, packaged, planned, and deferred capabilities.
- Keep changes focused, inspect all affected links, and run `python3 scripts/check_public_content.py`.
- Do not merge, modify access or licensing, disclose private information, or deploy without human authorization.
- Stop with `DECISION REQUIRED: <topic>` when publication rights, confidentiality, or technical assertions are uncertain.
